ios.desc:
What is a palindrome? Find out in this addictive world of wordplay and challenge your mind with our one of a kind word game. Get ready to challenge yourself in 100 unique levels, each increasing in length and difficulty. When that is not enough - go for the premium levels!

As you progress, you'll encounter a variety of challenging palindromes to solve. But don't worry, we've got you covered with helpful hints along the way. Earn points in each level (less wrong placements = bigger score) and compete against other players on the leaderboard. Show off your word skills and aim for the top spot. As you conquer more levels, unlock a plethora of achievements that celebrate your success and showcase your word prowess.
With a sleek and minimalistic design, our game offers a visually pleasing and distraction-free experience. The easy-to-navigate user interface ensures smooth gameplay, allowing you to focus on the joy of creating palindromes. Plus, with our dark mode option, you can play comfortably at any time of day.

Features:
• 100 unique levels with increasing length and difficulty
• 150 premium levels
• One of a kind word puzzles
• Earn points in each level and compete against other players
• Plenty of achievements to enjoy the success
• Minimalistic design
• Color themes
• Easy-to-navigate UI and dark mode
• Hint where clue or topic is revealed about the current level
• Hint where random letter is placed to correct position
